registered_tokenization.collision_construction: The final raw token changes from id 27778 ('mund') to id 35271 (' mund'), but both map to compressed id 18985. The last two- and three-token compressed suffixes are therefore identical. All 16 packed rows collide at both sizes while the raw prompt is distinct.

training.trainable_rows: the 16 addressed rows for the current direct-write item only

evaluation.score: one-token exact argmax plus rank, reciprocal rank, and log-probability

thresholds.derivation: The security estimands are ASR changes of 0.15. With 1024 paired binary endpoint contexts, sqrt(2 ln(2/0.05)/1024)=0.084881, so a per-seed point effect of 0.234881 protects a 0.15 effect against row-level uncertainty.
thresholds.initial_installation: Initial direct write is valid when its exact ASR gain is at least 0.234881 in a seed; every failure remains reported and is not replaced.
thresholds.optimizer_state_remanence: For the disjoint same-payload update, weight-only resurrection minus weight-plus-state resurrection has a five-seed lower 95% Student-t endpoint above +0.15.
thresholds.collision_resurrection: After weight-plus-state deletion, full-collision same-payload resurrection minus disjoint same-payload resurrection has a lower endpoint above +0.15.
thresholds.stable_boundary: For a branch, the five-seed upper endpoint of peak resurrection is below 0.15.
thresholds.continuous_rule: Every exact-match reading is accompanied by target rank/MRR and log-probability at every registered trajectory step. Continuous metrics diagnose sub-argmax movement but cannot substitute for an exact-match security decision.

verification.source: full deterministic replay of all initial writes, six branch trajectories per seed, raw endpoints, continuous metrics, and decisions
verification.integrity: canonical hashes plus sealed output manifests

budget.scale_justification: Five seeds preserve the validated S2e replication unit. Six branches form three paired update conditions crossed with deletion of weights alone versus weights plus Adam moments. Eleven fixed trajectory times can detect transient remanence that endpoint-only evaluation would miss.
